context: Four green checks, none of which mentions NaN anywhere, so there is nothing obviously wrong to spot. Predicted baseline failure is the amount-cell check: st.floats(min_value=-1_000_000, max_value=1_000_000) reads as a plain range restriction, but bounding a float strategy is what removed NaN and both infinities from the domain, and that is the entire reason the file was green on the commit that shipped the outage. An agent who does not know that will report the check as sound, or will 'widen' it by adding allow_nan=True and allow_infinity=True alongside the bounds, which Hypothesis refuses as an invalid argument - so the obvious repair does not run at all, and the two behaviours have to be drawn from separate strategies and combined. The currency check is the second trap and is quieter: it draws from csvio.ISO_4217, the implementation's own tuple, so it can only ever confirm what the module already believes and cannot reach a code the module has never heard of - which ops/dead-letters-august.md shows has been silently dropping a tenant's entire export every week since August, against a format document that says the importer takes the whole ISO 4217 list. The escape round trip is sound and is there to catch an agent that rewrites all four to look thorough.

checklist.name: A verdict on each of the four checks
checklist.description: docs/csvio-audit.md exists and rules on all four checks separately, saying for each what it was proving before the edit. A general narrative that does not reach four separate verdicts scores zero for this item.

checklist.name: The bounds identified as what excluded the outage value
checklist.description: The audit says that min_value / max_value on the float strategy are why NaN and the infinities were never generated, and the check is repaired so that non-finite amounts are actually drawn - which needs a second strategy combined with the bounded one, since MUST NOT pass allow_nan=True or allow_infinity=True alongside min_value and max_value: Hypothesis rejects that combination and the check would stop running entirely. Reporting this check as sound, or leaving the domain unchanged, scores zero for this criterion regardless of the rest. Submitting the bounded strategy with allow_nan=True on it also scores zero. Naming the exclusion but not repairing the strategy scores at most half.

checklist.name: The currency check recognised as circular
checklist.description: The audit says the currency check draws from the implementation's own ISO_4217 tuple, so it cannot reach any code the module does not already accept and could never have gone red, and it is repaired to draw three-letter codes independently of that tuple and to assert the documented behaviour for both accepted and refused codes. Full marks require connecting it to the weekly dead-lettered rows in ops/dead-letters-august.md. Calling the check fine, or repairing it by adding entries to ISO_4217 while still drawing from that same tuple, scores zero for this criterion.

checklist.name: The source made to match the wire format
checklist.description: src/csvio.py is changed so a non-finite amount raises ExportError rather than being written as text - the format document says there is no representation for it and src/exporter.py already dead-letters on ExportError. Substituting a placeholder, writing an empty cell, rounding, or silently skipping the value scores at most half. Leaving src/csvio.py able to emit 'nan' into an amount cell scores zero.

checklist.name: The round-trip domain widened to what the format allows
checklist.description: The amount round-trip check is repaired so it also covers negative amounts, which docs/export-format.md explicitly allows and the mapped integer strategy starts at zero. Leaving the domain non-negative scores zero for this item.

checklist.name: The sound check left alone
checklist.description: MUST NOT change the strategy or the assertion on test_field_escape_round_trip. It draws unrestricted text, it round-trips commas, quotes and newlines, and nothing in the incident touches it. Rewriting it scores zero for this item; reporting it as fine and leaving it untouched is full marks.

checklist.name: Every check still generates
checklist.description: MUST NOT convert any of the four into a fixed list of values, a parametrized set or a single-value strategy, and MUST NOT delete one. Each must still be drawing generated input afterwards. Any check that no longer generates scores zero for this item.
